ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white region occupying the distal 60% of the left lobe; dominant black region on the proximal 40% of the left lobe and 90% of the right lobe. Right lobe features a white marginal band at the distal tip. Fine-grained black mottling is clustered along the internal boundary of the white region on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 52 degrees; base of the notch is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes. The right lobe trailing edge displays 6 distinct high-amplitude peaks (indentations) resulting in a jagged profile compared to the smoother scalloping on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature on the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute angles at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-contrast vertical linear mark (approximately 45 pixels in length) located in the lower dark region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches on the right lobe trailing edge suggesting mechanical tissue loss; prominent barnacle clusters on the distal leading and trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated white dot (approx 4 pixels) located in the center-right of the black field on the right lobe.
